3 A train of mass 180 000 kg ascends a straight hill of length 1.5 km, inclined at an angle of 1.5° to the
horizontal. As it ascends the hill, the total work done to overcome the resistance to motion is 12 000 kJ
-1 -1
and the speed of the train decreases from 45m s to 40m s .
Find the work done by the engine of the train as it ascends the hill, giving your answer in kJ. 
4 A car of mass 1700 kg is pulling a trailer of mass 300 kg along a straight horizontal road. The car and
trailer are connected by a light inextensible cable which is parallel to the road. There are constant
resistances to motion of 400 N on the car and 150 N on the trailer. The power of the car’s engine is
14 000 W.
-1
Find the acceleration of the car and the tension in the cable when the speed is 20m s .

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
